project_type: C# .NET 8 WPF desktop application - multitrack worship backtrack player with lyric presenter module
build_system: dotnet CLI (.NET 9 SDK installed). Solution file: WorshipBacktrackPlayer.sln. On Linux, must use -p:EnableWindowsTargeting=true for WPF projects (net8.0-windows TFM). Core project (net8.0) builds natively on Linux.
test_framework: Must create WorshipPlayer.Tests project using xUnit (standard for .NET). No existing test project.
verification_instructions: 1. dotnet restore the solution. 2. dotnet build with EnableWindowsTargeting=true. 3. dotnet test the test project. The WPF XAML code-behind compiles with EnableWindowsTargeting but cannot run on Linux.
setup_instructions: dotnet restore WorshipBacktrackPlayer.sln. On Linux add -p:EnableWindowsTargeting=true to build. .NET 9 SDK is pre-installed at /root/.local/share/mise/dotnet-root/dotnet
environment_constraints: Running on Linux - WPF apps won't execute but will compile with EnableWindowsTargeting=true. Internet available for NuGet packages. Cannot run WPF at runtime, only compile. Tests must target net8.0 (not net8.0-windows) to actually run.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. Follow existing patterns: System.Text.Json for serialization, event-driven architecture, services are injected manually (no DI container), WPF code-behind pattern (no MVVM framework).
key_patterns: Models use [JsonPropertyName] attributes. Services fire events (EventHandler<T>). Audio engine uses NAudio ISampleProvider/IWaveProvider pipeline. Presenter uses double-buffer crossfade pattern for transitions. ChordProParserService handles chord parsing/transposition/stripping. Section.Text contains inline [chord] notation. ChartSlide provides timing data. ServiceOrderManager navigates items and fires ItemChanged events. PresenterEngine manages slide state and fires SlideChanged/ItemChanged/DisplayStateChanged events.
directory_structure: Root: WorshipBacktrackPlayer.sln, Songs/, Setlists/, ServiceOrders/, Scripts/, settings.json. WorshipPlayer.Core/ (net8.0) has Models/ and Services/. WorshipPlayer.Audio/ (net8.0-windows) has Engine/ and DSP/. WorshipPlayer.UI/ (net8.0-windows, WPF) has Views/. WorshipPlayer.Presenter/ (net8.0-windows, WPF) has Views/, Services/, Controls/, Models/, Resources/, Themes/ (most empty except Views and Services).
